required_stages.description: Scatter-copy of kv_nope into out_nope at rows dest_loc[t] (each element read once and written once in the algorithm, no atomics). The output buffers must not alias any input and need not be initialised from o_*: dest_loc is a permutation, so every row is overwritten; a device copy of o_* into the output is a permitted mapping (counted when performed), not a required stage.

Scatter-copy of kv_rope into out_rope at rows dest_loc[t]; s1 and s2 independent, may be one or two launches; returns (out_nope, out_rope) correct for the current call, with no result value carried over from an earlier call (an allocation may be reused only if the call fully overwrites every result element).

forbidden_substitutions.message: writes into o_nope / o_rope mutate an input
host-side indexed copy replaces the scatter kernel
preprocessing of dest_loc (sort / inverse permutation) is forbidden

possible cross-call result reuse: cached outputs or result values carried over from an earlier call are forbidden; an output allocation may be reused only if the call fully overwrites every result element (review the hit)

required_evidence.message: output buffers obtained inside run() (allocation, or a copy of o_*)

outputs.aliasing: none with any input; (out_nope, out_rope) have the shapes/dtypes of o_nope/o_rope and are correct for the current call; an output allocation may be reused across calls only if the call fully overwrites every result element (no cached result values)

timing_boundary.notes: The GPU time of all device work launched by run() is counted: the scatter launches and, if the implementation performs it, the device copy of o_* into the output buffers (a permitted mapping, not a required stage: dest_loc is a permutation, so every row is overwritten). bytes_expr is the compulsory source-read + result-write lower bound (n * dtype_size * 2); the dest_loc index reads are lower-order and omitted, and no candidate-specific initialisation term is added. Host-side work (allocation calls, flattening views, metadata reads) is not GPU time.
